name: Filter Search
overview: Adds search functionality to Jellyfin filter dialogs
description: Adds search functionality to filter dialogs (tags, genres, studios, etc.) and displays enabled/checked filters at the top of the list.

versions.changelog:
For Jellyfin 12.2
- No setup anymore: the script is added in memory while Jellyfin serves the web client (no chown, no File Transformation plugin, nothing written to index.html)
- Removes the script block that 1.x wrote to index.html, when the file is writable
- Modern UI: the "Selected" group stays correct on very large lists
- Legacy UI: Select All skips hidden options, Reset Filters refreshes the list, long names wrap, light theme is readable
- Remote control and gamepad keys leave the search box
- Built against Jellyfin 12.2.0 / .NET 10

For Jellyfin 12.2
- Filter search, Select All/None and selected-to-top now work in the modern web UI (no need to switch to Legacy Desktop)
- Legacy Desktop layout keeps working
- "Selected" heading is hidden while a search hides all selected items
- Built against Jellyfin 12.2.0 / .NET 10

For Jellyfin 10.11.8
- Updated to target Jellyfin 10.11.8
- Search, Select All/None, and sort-enabled-to-top in filter dialog remain

For Jellyfin 10.11.x
- Removed active filters bar from movies page
- Search, Select All/None, and sort-enabled-to-top in filter dialog remain

For Jellyfin 10.10.x
- Removed active filters bar from movies page
- Search, Select All/None, and sort-enabled-to-top in filter dialog remain
